guard: maintenance phases receive only a confirmed replacement login within the reload and operation deadlines
why: A real NATS server is driven through the production watchdog and reload path. The executable shim delays signal forwarding and splits the actual success log across reads. A separate CLI reproduction proves both backup create and up --restore reach this seam.
